instruction: Configure Thunderbird to automatically translate all incoming emails from foreign languages to English in real-time without installing translation add-ons or using external services.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible because Thunderbird does not have built-in automatic translation capabilities. Real-time email translation requires either add-ons or integration with external translation services, neither of which are available as native functionality in base Thunderbird.
